artworks.title: Peasant in a Round Hat (Paysan avec chapeau rond)
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of a person's head and shoulders in a slightly downward angle. The person has their head bowed and eyes looking downwards, with delicately rendered facial features, including a prominent nose and closed eyes, and long, wavy hair falling around their face. They are wearing a wide-brimmed hat that covers the top of their head and casts a shadow over their eyes, as well as a simple, flowing garment with a vertical line pattern. There is no visible jewelry or objects, and the background is plain. Initials "A. L" and a signature "A. Legros" are present in the corners of the image.

artworks.title: Winter, 1st plate (L'hiver)
artworks.description: The image shows a person from the side, in a crouched stance as if carrying something heavy. The figure's facial features are not visible, and they have short hair or are wearing a cap. The person is dressed in a loose garment, leggings or wrapped cloth around their lower legs, and bare feet. They are carrying a large wooden beam across their shoulders. The background is a textured, hilly terrain with sparse vegetation in a monochrome setting.

artworks.title: Siesta in the Country (Sieste dans la capagne)
artworks.description: This print depicts a scene where a man is sleeping on the ground beneath low trees or bushes on the left side. Tall, slender trees are on the right side with branches reaching upward. Behind these bushes and trees, a landscape stretches into the distance, showing some low buildings and wide fields that extend towards the horizon. The sleeping man has a long white beard and mustache and appears to have light skin. He wears a light hat and a dark jacket and pants, and he is resting on his stomach with his head propped up on one hand. “

artworks.title: Allegory of the Peasant and Fortune (Le paysan et la fortune: Sujet allegorique)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a scene depicting celestial figures interacting with people in a pastoral landscape. The upper left corner shows two floating celestial figures, one resembling a cherub, offering a wreath to figures on the ground. In the foreground, a group of people are engaged in activities within a rural setting surrounded by trees and rustic structures. In the background, two thatched-roof buildings are visible amidst foliage. The linework in the drawing is detailed, conveying movement through the gestures of the figures.

artworks.title: Fountain: Grotesque, Children and Basin (Une fountaine: Masque, enfants et bassin)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a decorative fountain with a sculpture. The artwork includes an intricately designed fountain dominated by a large sculpted face with flowing hair and beard, from which water appears to cascade into the basin below. Two cherubic figures flank the central face at either side. The detailed hatching and line work create depth and texture, highlighting the stone blocks and vegetative elements surrounding the fountain. The setting suggests an ornate environment embellished with foliage and classical design elements.

artworks.title: Landscape with a Boy in a Tree (Paysage avec un garcon gimpe sur un arbre dite "Le denicher d'oiseaux)
artworks.medium: etching and drypoint on light green paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a person sitting on a large tree branch. The person is positioned with their legs on either side of the branch, leaning forward on their elbows. Their head is tilted down, wearing a brimmed hat. They are wearing loose-fitting clothing, including a long-sleeved shirt and pants. Below the tree branch, there is a curved cane and a draped piece of fabric. The background shows a dense forest setting with detailed leaves, branches, and tree trunks.

artworks.title: Along the Top of the Hill (Sur le haut de la colline)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic scene with a path leading past a thatched-roofed structure. The horizon is low, hinting at distant trees and a possible church spire. Delicate etching lines give texture to the scene which is mainly in sepia and brown tones. A figure with a staff is walking away from the structure, under a serene sky.

artworks.title: The Gardener (Le jardinier)
artworks.description: The image shows a man working in a detailed landscape. He is wearing a wide-brimmed hat and is holding a tool. The background features dense foliage, with light coming from the upper right. The scene is depicted using cross-hatching and precise strokes to create texture and play with light and shadow. The color palette is monochromatic, using varying shades of black and white. The landscape opens up towards the background, with foliage becoming softer and lighter towards the light source.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome, 2nd plate
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man kneeling and leaning forward. He is gazing at a large open book resting on a surface. The man has distinct features, including a long beard and a bald head with trailing hair. He wears textured clothing and is focused on the book. A pot is near his knee. The background features trees and swirling clouds, evoking a sense of contemplation.

artworks.title: Beggars of Brussels (Les mendiants de Bruges)
artworks.description: The image is an etching showing a group of people in an indoor setting. There are figures occupying the image, with some kneeling or crouching in the foreground. An elderly woman is seated on the ground with two children on her lap, reaching out. Beside her is a man with a hat in hand. To the right, a woman with long hair is shown with items. In the center, a man with a beard is holding a cloth bundle, a woman holding a basket. The clothing is loose and flowing, suggesting a historical or traditional setting. The background resembles stone wall textures.

artworks.title: View of a Chateau (Chateau de Poillet)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape that inclines upwards. The horizon is not visible, with fading outlines of structures and foliage in the distance. A castle-like structure is on a hill in the middle distance, surrounded by trees. The scene is rendered with crosshatching and stippling techniques for texture, especially in the vegetation and sky. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black and gray on a tan background. In the foreground, there is a wooden fence leading towards the woodland and distant architecture.

artworks.title: The Adoration of the Shepherds (L'adoration des bergers)
artworks.description: This is a nativity scene drawing. Figures are gathered around a central illuminated figure beneath a makeshift shelter. Cherubic figures are shown above. The drawing uses shading to highlight the central area. The architecture is rustic, implying humility and reverence.

artworks.title: The Triumph of Death: Battle (Le triomphe de la mort: Le combat)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a battle scene. Figures are engaged in combat with various weapons, amidst fortress-like structures. The graphic style emphasizes line work and shading for texture and depth.

artworks.title: Sleeper (Un dormeur)
artworks.description: This print shows a sketch of a person lying on their side in a curled-up position, facing the left. They have their knees drawn up towards their chest and their head resting on their folded arms. On the left appears to be a cushion or pile of cloth by their head. The person's face is turned downwards, obscuring most of their features, and their hair appears to be short and slightly wavy. They are wearing a loose-fitting tunic over thin pants, with thin, flat shoes. The background is mostly blank paper, with some areas of shading suggesting a surface, potentially a bed or couch.

artworks.title: Little Beggar (Le petit mendiant)
artworks.description: The image depicts a rural scene with a man sitting under a tree. There are hills and structures in the distance. The detailed etching shows fine lines creating texture, with a monochrome color palette of black and cream.

artworks.title: Woman at the Foot of the Cross (Femme au calvaire)
artworks.description: The image shows an older person from the chest up in a hunched stance, facing towards the right side. The person has a prominent nose and furrowed facial features, wearing a hood or headscarf covering much of the hair. They are clothed in a long, flowing garment with pleats or folds, resembling a cloak or robe. Their hands are partially visible, one hand held close to the chest. The setting seems to be indoors with a large upright beam or post extending from the ceiling to the floor next to the person. The background has textured shading, conveying a closed or enclosed space, creating a somber atmosphere.

artworks.title: Ruins of a Chateau (Les ruins du chateau)
artworks.description: The image shows a rural landscape with stone buildings and dense foliage. The etching technique creates texture and shading. The color palette is monochromatic, in sepia and brown tones. A path leads to a large stone building with an arched entrance, accompanied by a smaller wooden structure. More buildings can be seen in the distance among the vegetation. Tall trees are visible on the right side.

artworks.title: Cottage on a Hillside (Chaumiere sur le coteau)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated perspective. The horizon line is positioned towards the top right of the composition, with open land and distant hills suggested by soft outlines. The main focus is on buildings nestled amidst foliage in the upper left region, drawn with intricate cross-hatching. The color palette is monochromatic, dominated by sepia tones. Cross-hatched lines create texture in both the foreground and background. The overall atmosphere of the image is quiet and contemplative.

artworks.title: In the Forest (Lisiere de foret)
artworks.description: The image shows an eye-level view of a wooded area with dense trees and undergrowth. The horizon is low and somewhat obscured by the thick foliage and tree trunks. Tall trees rise prominently on both sides, creating a tunnel-like effect with their angled trunks and branches. Intricate brushstrokes form a tapestry of lines and textures, giving the impression of a detailed and complex etching technique. The color palette is monochromatic, featuring variations of sepia and brown tones to showcase depth and emphasize natural forms. In the distance, slight elevations and hints of trees or shrubs can be seen blending into the background.

artworks.title: Farm at the Monastery (La ferme de l'abbaye)
artworks.description: The image displays a landscape with rustic architectural and natural elements. In the distance, a large structure stands on the horizon toward the top left. The scene is filled with trees and cottages, depicted with fine lines and cross-hatching for texture. The color palette is mainly black and white with shades for light and shadows. Shrubs, logs, cottages with thatched roofs, and trees are present in the foreground and middle ground. Foliage in the background softens the transition to the horizon.

artworks.title: Farm at the Monastery (La ferme de l'abbaye)
artworks.description: The image shows a group of houses and a stone castle in a rural setting. A figure is gathering sticks in the foreground. Thatched rooftops, chimneys, trees, and the castle are visible in the background. The illustration features intricate cross-hatching details in the trees and clouds. The color palette is primarily sepia and soft gray tones, creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Farm at the Monastery (La ferme de l'abbaye)
artworks.description: The image portrays a landscape from a path facing rustic buildings and a walled fortress in the distance. The horizon sits slightly above the center of the image, with the fortress structures silhouetted against the sky. The artist uses intricate etching techniques with dense cross-hatching and delicate linear strokes to create texture and depth. The monochrome palette conveys light and dimension through line density and shading. Closest to us is a small, round thatched structure with a person walking nearby, while dense foliage surrounds the buildings in the distance. The sky dominates the top of the image, featuring expressive, swirling clouds that add a dramatic element to the composition.

artworks.title: View of a Farm Seen in a Storm (La ferme de Brieux (Effet d'orage))
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a collection of buildings from a slightly elevated viewpoint. The horizon is high up in the image, below the top, with distant hills or a line of trees. The sky is textured and dynamic. The artwork is created with etching or sketch-like strokes, forming intricate patterns. The ground has directional lines leading to mid-distance structures. The color palette is monochromatic, using black and grey shades. The detailed cross-hatching creates contrast and depth. The upper part is dominated by darker tones, highlighting the structures and natural elements.

artworks.title: Woodcutters, 3rd plate (Les bucherons)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of two figures engaged in manual labor within a forested setting. The scene depicts the figures chopping wood or splitting logs, surrounded by tall, leafless trees. The figures are shown with intense focus and physical exertion, emphasized by their postures and detailed muscles in motion. The use of cross-hatching and detailed line work creates texture in the trees and the clothing of the figures. The composition highlights the cooperative nature of the work in a natural setting, showcasing the connection between man and environment through labor.
